title: Stokes formula for one oriented lattice unit cube
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P arbitrary, b ∈ ℤ^P, and let γ be a C¹ m-form on Euclid P. Put Φ(y) := toLp(b) + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} and E := (e_{ι(j)})_j. For i ∈ Fin (m+1) let E'_i := (e_{ι(succAbove i l)})_{l∈Fin m} and define the front and back faces Φ¹_i(y') := toLp(b + 𝟙_{ι(i)}) + Σ_l y'_l e_{ι(succAbove i l)} and Φ⁰_i(y') := toLp(b) + Σ_l y'_l e_{ι(succAbove i l)}, where 𝟙_{ι(i)} = Pi.single (ι i) 1 ∈ ℤ^P. With Q^d the open unit cube of Euclid d: ∫_{Q^{m+1}} dγ(Φ(y))(E) dy = Σ_{i∈Fin(m+1)} (−1)^i (∫_{Q^m} γ(Φ¹_i(y'))(E'_i) dy' − ∫_{Q^m} γ(Φ⁰_i(y'))(E'_i) dy').
